newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade lighter, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade lighter, prices mixed.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume slipped to 1,639 kilos on Thursday, from Wednesday's 2,715 kilos as demand eased ahead of the weekend, dealers said.

Gold prices were mixed, closing easier in dollar terms at $343.50 an ounce, from $344.00 on Wednesday, but firming in lira terms to 1,529,500 lira per gram from a previous 1,527,000 as the Turkish currency weakened against the dollar.
The lira closed at 138,430 lira to the dollar, versus 138,080 at Wednesday's close as the dollar strengthened against the mark in world markets.

"Dealers prefer to buy the gold they need at the beginning of the week, so demand usually decreases by Thursday and Friday. Apart from that, seasonal physical demand is slowly rising and there was also arbitrage by the banks," one dealer said.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,394 kilos -- took place in the morning session and 67.3 percent of the total was in lira terms.
